rule_groups.title: All Matches
rule_groups.description: Rules that apply to all matches.

rule_groups.title: Pools of 5 - Mixed
rule_groups.description: Additional rules for five-team Mixed pools.

rule_groups.title: Pools of 5 - Men
rule_groups.description: Additional rules for five-team Men's pools.

rules.title: All Matches Rule 1
rules.html: Standard FIVB Indoor rules apply except as listed in the relevant pool rules.

rules.title: All Matches Rule 3
rules.html: League points: 1 point for a win and 0 points for a loss.

rules.title: All Matches Rule 4
rules.html: If league points end in a tie, a coefficient based on Sets For and Sets Against ratio will be used.

rules.title: All Matches Rule 5
rules.html: If the sets coefficient ends in a tie, a coefficient based on Points For and Points Against ratio will be used.

rules.title: All Matches Rule 6
rules.html: If the points coefficient ends in a tie, the team with higher Points For wins.

rules.title: All Matches Rule 7
rules.html: If all of this still results in a tie, a coin toss will decide the winner.

rules.title: Pools of 5 - Mixed Rule 1
rules.html: All matches are best of 3 sets.

rules.title: Pools of 5 - Mixed Rule 2
rules.html: First two sets: play to 21 points, capped at 23.

rules.title: Pools of 5 - Mixed Rule 3
rules.html: Third set: first to 11 points. No win-by-two.

rules.title: Pools of 5 - Mixed Rule 4
rules.html: Teams in Mixed divisions must have at least THREE women on court at all times.

rules.title: Pools of 5 - Men Rule 1
rules.html: All matches are best of 3 sets.

rules.title: Pools of 5 - Men Rule 2
rules.html: First two sets: play to 25 points, capped at 27.

rules.title: Pools of 5 - Men Rule 3
rules.html: Third set: play to 15 points, capped at 17.

rules.title: Pools of 4 Rule 1
rules.html: All matches are best of 3 sets.

rules.title: Pools of 4 Rule 2
rules.html: First two sets: play to 25 points, win by 2 points.

rules.title: Pools of 4 Rule 3
rules.html: Third set: play to 15 points, capped at 19.

rules.title: Pools of 4 Rule 4
rules.html: Teams in Mixed divisions must have at least THREE women on court at all times.
